ambient_events: The elevator settles behind you with a soft, expensive sigh.
The hololock on the penthouse door pulses once, a slow bead of light, and goes still.
description: A private landing the size of most people's apartments, and it holds exactly one door. Pale stone underfoot, a single orchid on a plinth, and light that comes from nowhere you can point to. The far wall is taken up by a seamless slab of brushed bronze, the entrance to the penthouse, with a discreet plate beside it reading J. AKERSON and a hololock that watches you back. The elevator waits in behind you. There is nowhere else to go up here, and that is plainly the point.
name: The Penthouse Landing
